# Eject widens the opt-in: the fork enables extended CONNECT per server
# while stock Go offers only the process-global GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1.
# The rewritten call requires that setting and panics naming the server
# otherwise, so ejected servers fail fast instead of serving without it.

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd m
logos run .
stdout '^h2 extended connect ready$'
stdout '^deferred registered: true$'
stdout '^async registered: true$'
cp stdout $WORK/native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
! grep 'EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect' out/main.go
grep 'RequireExtendedConnect' out/main.go
grep 'ejectedhttp "github.com/gosuda/loGos/rt/net/http"' out/main.go
! grep 'os.Getenv' out/main.go
! grep 'strings.Contains' out/main.go
grep 'func RequireExtendedConnect' out/_logos_deps/rt/net/http/h2extendedconnect.go
cd out
go build ./...
env GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1
go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
env GODEBUG=
! exec go run .
stderr 'needs GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1'
stderr 'on server "srv"'
env GODEBUG=http2xconnect=1
exec go run .
cmp stdout $WORK/native.txt
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec $UPROOT1272/bin/go version
stdout '^go version go1\.27\.2 '
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go build ./...
cd ..

# A receiver that carries error-tracing temporaries from '?' inside an
# inline callback cannot be rewritten without overlapping the tracing
# edits, so eject leaves it alone. Verification must refuse it instead of
# passing a fork-only method into output upstream Go rejects.
cd ../trace
logos run .
stdout '^trace receiver stays native$'
! logos eject -o out
stderr 'fork_stdlib_api'
cd ..

# A module whose only net/http import and extended-CONNECT call live in
# a non-host variant still needs the helper package in the output: the
# variant inventory carries no import edges, so the seed-based roots miss
# logos/net/http and the support bundle is selected from the imports the
# rewrite actually emitted instead.
cd variant
logos run .
stdout '^other ready$'
logos eject -o out
grep 'RequireExtendedConnect' out/server_windows.go
grep 'ejectedhttp "github.com/gosuda/loGos/rt/net/http"' out/server_windows.go
env GOOS=windows
env CGO_ENABLED=0
cd out
go build ./...
cd ../..

-- m/go.mod --
module example.com/h2xconnect

go 1.27

-- m/main.lgo --

// Command h2xconnectdemo exercises eject of the extended-connect opt-in.
package main

import (
	"context"
	"crypto/tls"
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	sys "os"
)

var registry = map[string]*http.Server{}

var mode = sys.Getenv("H2XCONNECT_MODE")

func getOrCreate(name string) *http.Server {
	if s, ok := registry[name]; ok {
		return s
	}
	s := &http.Server{
		Addr:      "127.0.0.1:0",
		TLSConfig: &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS13},
		Handler:   http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}),
	}
	registry[name] = s
	return s
}

func run() error {
	srv := &http.Server{
		Addr:      "127.0.0.1:0",
		TLSConfig: &tls.Config{MinVersion: tls.VersionTLS13},
		Handler:   http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {}),
	}
	srv.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
	strings := "shadow"
	_ = strings
	_ = mode
	defer getOrCreate("deferred").EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
	go group (context.Background()) {
		go getOrCreate("async").EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
	}
	fmt.Println("h2 extended connect ready")
	fmt.Println("deferred registered:", registry["deferred"] != nil)
	fmt.Println("async registered:", registry["async"] != nil)
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := run(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

-- trace/go.mod --
module example.com/h2trace

go 1.27

-- trace/main.lgo --

// Command h2tracedemo covers the unrewritable receiver: '?' inside the
// inline callback leaves tracing temporaries in the receiver subtree.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

func loadConfig() (string, error) {
	return "cfg", nil
}

func makeServer(init func() error) *http.Server {
	if err := init(); err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
	return &http.Server{Addr: "127.0.0.1:0"}
}

func main() {
	makeServer(func() error { loadConfig()?; return nil }).EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
	fmt.Println("trace receiver stays native")
}

-- variant/go.mod --
module example.com/h2variant

go 1.27

-- variant/server_windows.lgo --
//go:build windows

package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
)

func main() {
	srv := &http.Server{Addr: "127.0.0.1:0"}
	srv.EnableHTTP2ExtendedConnect()
	fmt.Println("windows ready")
}

-- variant/server_other.lgo --
//go:build !windows

package main

import "fmt"

func main() { fmt.Println("other ready") }
